b0c52680: ;Clean up %Z variable used to store SERVICE CONNECTED field
92fc8e7b:
59241448: Increment the DQ subscript to point to the next node in the DIC reader
11512f2e: Branch to the code indicated by the current DQ subscript
98232b97: Go to the RE label if the current DQ node exists in the DE array, otherwise execute the W and TR labels
5ad8277a: If X is blank, go to the A label if DV doesn't contain 'R', go to the X label if DV is empty or D is negative, otherwise go to the A label
05646c02: If X starts with '?', go to the QS label, otherwise if X starts with '^', execute the D label and branch to ^DIE17
4295cc14: If X is '@', execute the D label and branch to Z^DIE2

2c2a2d49: If X is a space, DV contains 'd', DV doesn't contain 'P', and the DIE user-defined node for the current field exists, set X to the value from that node and write it if DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S'

d5c1ebdc: If DV is defined, go to M^DIE17, if DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3, if DV doesn't contain 'S', go to the P label, otherwise execute code from DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) if it exists. Set % to the value following ';X:' in DU, and Y to X. If % is non-blank, execute DIC('S') code if it exists. If DB(DQ) is undefined, write '% '. If % is blank, go to the V label

0cf4f950: Loop through each ';'-piece of DU. Set Y to the piece and DG to the position of ':X' in Y. If Y is blank, go to the X label. Set YS to Y, and Y to the part before ':'. If DG is non-zero, execute DIC('S') code if it exists. If DG is non-zero, quit the loop
0d967a6c: If DB(DQ) is undefined, write the substring of YS starting at position DG. Set X to the part of YS before the ':'.
2b3bbd73: If an invalid entry is made, exit without updating.
cdd90703: If the user enters a number exceeding 24 digits, reject the entry.

264e499e: If there is a maximum length specified and the entry contains a decimal point, ensure that the number of digits after the decimal point does not exceed the maximum length. If the entry is a whole number, convert the trailing decimal point to an integer.
5034d273: Execute the cross-reference routine for the field.
040afe88: Clean up variables and store the entered value in the global for auditing if the variable DISV is defined.
3a57a506: Branch to Z^DIE17 if the input value is defined in the DB array for the current input field.
ee4e3bfb: Set the default value of X to '?BAD' if the input value is not defined in DB.
7af28d2f: Execute the D, QQ^DIEQ routines and branch to B after setting the DZ variable to the input value X.
427ed7e9: Set the D variable to the current field number, populate the DQ array with field properties from the DATA section, and return.

854ec884: If the input transform (DE) is not defined for the current field, execute the O routine. If the input is not '@', branch to RD. If the input is '@' and the field is not read-only, branch to A. If the input is '@', set X to Y and branch to N.
bfe549a4: Set DG to the field specifier, Y to the input transform (DE), and X to the input value. If the DQ(DQ,2) input transform is defined, execute it. Then branch to RP.
54092b1b: If the data global is pointed to by a file, get the relevant fields from the file/sub-file/data dictionaries for pointer resolution.
3a17b1ef: If the data global is pointed to by a VARIABLE pointer, get the relevant fields from the variable pointer global/data dictionaries for pointer resolution.

ed386f3d: If the data global is a sub-dictionary, execute the appropriate code from the sub-dictionary for pointer resolution. If it's a sub-file global, get the sub-file number from the sub-file global name.
